title: feat(i18n): serve labels by i18n.sourceLocale as the authored language
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9S57hqQnFxsopofbjbzbR6p)_

Fixes #33634
Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: follow-up #34053

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：运行时现在读取 `i18n.sourceLocale`，把它当作元数据内联标签的原文语言；i18n 服务契约新增可选的 `getSourceLocale` / `setSourceLocale`。
- 为什么改：英文写元数据、默认给用户中文的应用，没配 `fallbackLocale` 时，英文请求拿到的是中文标签；工具已把 `en` 报成 100% 覆盖，运行时却不这么服务。
- 风险与回滚：只影响声明了 `sourceLocale` 的应用；没声明的应用答案逐字不变（每个入口都有对照测试）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/contracts/i18n-service.ts`（新契约方法的语义）、`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`（元数据读取的取值顺序）、`packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts`（声明如何注入服务）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/meta-i18n-declared-fallback-chain.test.ts`，预期 25 个测试全绿，其中 §6 六个是本卡的钉子。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

An app authored in English that defaults its users to `zh-CN` (`defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, `sourceLocale: 'en'`, no `fallbackLocale`, a `zh-CN` pack) used to serve an `en` request the Chinese row: every caller that builds the label resolver's options passed `getDefaultLocale()` as `ResolveOptions.defaultLocale` (the authored language), so `en` was not "the authored one" and walked the fallback chain (`zh-CN`, the boot paths' collapse) ahead of the inline text. Route A of the census report (issuecomment 6894743586), chosen by the seat:

- **Contract** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/i18n-service.ts`): optional `getSourceLocale(): string | undefined` and `setSourceLocale(locale): void`. Same stance as the fallback pair: implementing one does not oblige the other (per-value); the getter answers only what was declared and never derives `defaultLocale` — that collapse is the caller's. The `getDefaultLocale` jsdoc no longer claims it is always the authored language.
- **Producers**: `AppPlugin.loadTranslations` threads `i18n.sourceLocale` beside `setDefaultLocale` / `setFallbackLocale`, guarded on "declared something" (a sibling app on the same kernel keeps its value). `FileI18nAdapter` and the kernel's in-memory fallback implement both halves. Measured: `os serve` and plugin-dev construct `I18nServicePlugin` with `defaultLocale` / `fallbackLocale` only, and `AppPlugin` then calls the setters on the adapter it built, so neither boot path needed a new option (`serve.ts`, `dev-i18n.ts` untouched).
- **The five option builders**, each now `getSourceLocale()` (non-empty) else `getDefaultLocale()` as `ResolveOptions.defaultLocale`, fallback chain untouched: rest `metaTranslateOptions` (also behind `RestServer.translateOptionsFor`, `form-routes.ts` and the runtime dispatcher's list translation), objectql `formula-option-labels.ts`, plugin-email `option-label-table.ts`, service-analytics `translateSelectOptions`, service-storage `record-file-access.ts` `labelsIn`. The census re-run on `895783a1` (every non-test `fallbackChain` / `getDefaultLocale` reader under `packages/`) found no sixth builder; the only other `fallbackChain` site is `ui/packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-formatters.ts`, a client formatter fed from its own config, not from `II18nService` (noted below).
- **Users'-default readers unchanged**: service-messaging recipient locale and notification text, runtime `domains/i18n.ts`, discovery, AppPlugin seed locale, `extractLocale` (a header-less request still falls to `defaultLocale`), plugin-auth (not touched).
- **Prose made false, corrected in the same PR**: `TranslationConfigSchema.sourceLocale` jsdoc and `.describe` ("Not yet read by the serving layer"), `ResolveOptions.defaultLocale` jsdoc and the resolver header, the `RestServer.translateOptionsFor` docblock, the regenerated `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`, and three hand-written doc pages that described the old rule or told authors to add `fallbackLocale: 'en'` as a workaround. Shared read helper: inline (five 3-line copies); no new `@objectstack/spec/system` export.

## Tests

Each builder has a pin with `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, `sourceLocale: 'en'`, no `fallbackLocale` (collapsed to `zh-CN`): an `en` request answers the inline English label, a `zh-CN` request the `zh-CN` row, and a CONTROL with no `sourceLocale` keeps today's answer (`zh-CN` row for `en`).

- rest `meta-i18n-declared-fallback-chain.test.ts` §6: single read, list read, header-less request (falls to `zh-CN`), a third locale (`ja-JP` walks the chain to `zh-CN`), controls with the accessor absent and answering `undefined`.
- objectql `engine-formula-option-label.test.ts`, plugin-email `template-option-labels.integration.test.ts` (booted kernel), service-analytics `picklist-dimension-label-i18n.test.ts` (both strategies), service-storage `record-file-access.integration.test.ts` (the upload-link page, English and Chinese).
- Producers: `fallbacks.test.ts` (memory provider), `file-i18n-adapter.test.ts`, `app-plugin.test.ts` (threads, does not call when undeclared, skips a provider without the setter), spec `i18n-service.test.ts`.
- Forced test edits: none. Two harness widenings to reach the pins: the rest file's `protocol()` / `makeRest()` take an optional document map, and the plugin-email `AppFixture` takes accessor overrides; every existing case runs with the defaults it had.

<details><summary>Readings (local, shared container; packages built at the head the suites ran on)</summary>

- Full suites, the nine consumer packages (downstream direction: the packages that read the widened contract), one locked run: spec 842 files / 26958 tests, core 147 / 3404, objectql 596 / 13174, service-i18n 4 / 73, plugin-email 53 / 1020, service-analytics 215 / 5220 (335 skipped), service-storage 86 / 1652 (1 skipped), rest 412 / 8448 (332 skipped), runtime 605 / 10961 (19 skipped): all passed. Typecheck green in all nine (runtime's test layer after building `driver-turso`, a devDependency outside the first build closure).
- Ablation, one per changed builder plus the producer (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proven on disk, file restored to its HEAD blob each time): rest source read removed → 2 of 25 red (§6 single and list read); objectql → 1 of 9 red; plugin-email → 1 of 4 red; service-analytics → 2 of 30 red (one per strategy); service-storage → 1 of 90 red; `AppPlugin` `setSourceLocale` call removed → 1 of 39 red. Each test file imports the source under test, so no rebuild was needed for the legs.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: one stale artifact (`content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`), regenerated; `api-surface` unchanged (an optional interface member).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/utils/spec-formatters.ts` builds a `fallbackChain` from its own client config, not from `II18nService`; it is outside this route (the Console's own locale config). Not filed.
- A regional request in the source language (`en-US` against `sourceLocale: 'en'`) is not recognised as the authored one: `isDefaultLocale` compares tags exactly (case-insensitive), the same as it always did for `defaultLocale`. Unchanged by this PR; noted, not filed.

## Verification

Verification head: `b63efd08`, a merge-only commit of `origin/main` (`e71ecc1b`, 15 commits past the previous merge) made under the seat's K ≥ 15 landing rule; CI on this head is the landing verdict. No file this PR changes moved on main's side. The local readings below were taken at `5156e558` (suites, ablations, derived gates, HTTP door) and `74a2954d` (the first merge of `main`: full rebuild, `check:generated` green with nothing to regenerate).

<details><summary>HTTP door, booted</summary>

The todo example in a side worktree at this head, set to `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN'`, `sourceLocale: 'en'`, no `fallbackLocale`, and its `en` bundle dropped (so English can only come from the inline labels); `pnpm dev --fresh`, signed in as the dev admin, `GET /api/v1/meta/object/todo_task`:

- `Accept-Language: en` → `Task` / `Tasks` / field `Subject` (inline English)
- `Accept-Language: zh-CN` → `任务` / `任务` / `主题`
- `Accept-Language: ja-JP` → `タスク` / `タスク` / `件名`
- no header → `任务` (the users' default)
- CONTROL, same stack without `sourceLocale`: `en` → `任务` / `任务` / `主题` (the card's defect, unchanged for a stack that declares nothing).

The example edits lived only in that throwaway worktree; it was removed after both servers were stopped.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (head 5156e558)</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on head `5156e558`: 130 commands, all run, all exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 130 derived, 130 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first round (head `75656a8b`) found one real red, `check:test-source-alias` on the edited rest test (the routes reach `@objectstack/objectql` through a dynamic import inside a case's clock); fixed in `5156e558` with a module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql'`, the shape the package's other door tests use. Its other two non-zero exits were environment: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exit 3 until its pinned commit was fetched into the shallow clone, and `check:generated`'s embedded `check:test-typecheck` tsc run failing without diagnostics at the default heap (green at the CI heap, 4096 MB).

</details>
